description:
A Standout Family Home with Style, Space and Exceptional Presentation comes to the open market with this four-bedroom end-of-terrace, B3 energy rating, approx 118.2 sq.m (1,272 sq.ft) built c.2007 this home combines modern elegance with everything a growing family needs. Throughout the property, modern décor and tasteful finishes create a bright, contemporary environment that is both stylish and practical, comprising of well-proportioned accommodation, complemented by a private rear garden and an attractive outlook over a large green.

The accommodation comprises of the entrance hallway, featuring bespoke-style wall panelling and a solid oak staircase, guest WC recently refurbished and tiled. The spacious sitting room has a front aspect with laminate flooring, bespoke fitted storage units and wall panelling, double doors leading to the fully fitted modern kitchen/dining room with a dual aspect and patio doors leading to the private rear garden. The first floor comprises of a carpeted landing with hot-press, side window aspect and Velux window. Four bedrooms, three with slide robes. The master with recently refurbished and retiled ensuite. Bedroom four is currently being used as a dressing room with built in storage and carpet flooring. The main family bathroom again has been recently refurbished and fully tiled.

The exterior of this home is equally as well maintained as the interior with tarmac driveway to the front offering ample car parking space, a private well fenced rear garden having an imprinted concrete patio area with patio lights, artificial lawn, enclosed oil tank, shed with concrete base and power supply, pedestrian gate to the side entrance.

Castlepollard town centre which offers all necessary amenities including a selection of local shops, pubs, Church’s, Tesco shopping centre, two primary schools and a post primary school, post office, library, Castlevaragh Hotel, two doctors’ surgeries and the new playground. Within easy access of many lakes and rivers for water sport and fishing, Tullynally Castle, gardens and tea rooms for forestry walks on your door step. Lough Lene Blue Flag Lake in Collinstown is less than a 10-minute drive, famed for fishing, swimming and water sports. The historical village of Fore is just 6km from Castlepollard for local primary school, coffee shops, country pubs, visitors' centre and the Barrel & Bean distillery and café.

Castlepollard is a key location for access in travel to Dublin on the M50 approx 40 mins, Mullingar approx 12km, other key routes include Athlone, Tullamore and Galway. Serviced with the New TFI Local Link 818 Mullingar to Castlepollard via Collinstown, offering 5 daily return services Monday to Thursday, 8 on Friday, 7 on Saturday and 5 on Sundays.

Viewing is highly recommended.
